in_sanskrit.name: अन्सुल्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'ansula' which means 'radiant'. It is often used to describe something or someone that shines brightly or emanates light.

in_hindi.name: अन्सुल
in_hindi.long_meaning: Ansul in Hindi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ansula'. While 'ansula' means 'radiant', in Hindi it is interpreted as 'endless' or 'infinite'. This name is often given to a child who is believed to possess qualities that are endless or infinite.

in_tamil.name: அன்சுல்

in_telugu.name: అన్సుల్
